title: Local cocartesian edges agree with global lifts when transport exists
statement: Use small quasicategories, equivalence edges and simplicial pullbacks of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and inner fibrations and cocartesian edges of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $p:E\to C$ be an inner fibration between quasicategories. For an edge $a:c\to d$ in $C$ put $E_a=E\times_{C,a}\Delta^1$, and call an edge $u:x\to y$ over $a$ locally cocartesian when $(u,\mathrm{id}_{\Delta^1})$ is cocartesian for $E_a\to\Delta^1$. If a global $p$-cocartesian lift of $a$ exists with source $x$, then $u$ is locally cocartesian if and only if it is $p$-cocartesian. For a degenerate base edge $a=\mathrm{id}_c$, these equivalent conditions are also equivalent to $u$ being an equivalence in the vertex fibre $E_c=E\times_C\{c\}$. Consequently, for a fully scaled categorical pattern $\mathfrak P=(C,S,\{p_\alpha\})$ and a $\mathfrak P$-fibered marked object $(E,T)\to(C,S)$ of [def-coef-categorical-pattern-fibrancy], $T$ consists exactly of the locally cocartesian edges over $S$, and its edges over $\mathrm{id}_c$ are exactly the equivalences of $E_c$.
